entries.设备探测 + GPU 合成通道；求值仍在 CPU，无图形设备时自动退回: Device probing plus a GPU compositing pass; evaluation stays on CPU and falls back when no graphics device is available
entries.图求值在 CPU，整帧合成走 GPU 着色器；无图形设备时自动退回标准 CPU: Graph evaluation on CPU, whole-frame compositing through a GPU shader; falls back to the standard CPU backend without a graphics device.
entries.GPU 后处理的锐化量；0 = 只上传不下指令（等同关闭）。仅在渲染后端选到 G: Sharpen amount for the GPU pass; 0 disables it. Only applies when the GPU compositing backend is selected.
